Method · step 1 of 5

Blitz the liver smooth — 2 min

Blend 200 g beef (or rabbit) liver until completely smooth — it should pour. This is what hides it.

Done looks like: smooth, pourable, no lumps.

Screen stays on while you cook

Method · step 2 of 5

Mix everything together — 5 min

Squeeze the water from the grated zucchini, carrot & onion. Fold together: mince, liver, the veg, egg, the herbs (+ a few mint leaves), gelatin, ground pumpkin seeds and all the seasoning.

Done looks like: one even, soft mixture.

Screen stays on while you cook

Method · step 3 of 5

Shape the cutlets — 5 min

With wet hands, shape the mix into even oval cutlets, all a similar size. Softer than plain mince — that’s right.

Done looks like: a tray of even ovals, all a similar size.

Screen stays on while you cook

Method · step 4 of 5

Cook through — 8 min a side

Pan-fry in 1 tbsp ghee over medium heat, about 8 min each side — until cooked through. Or bake at 190°C for 25 min.

Side 1
Side 2

Tap a running timer to pause · Reset starts it over.

Timer finished — check the cutlets.

No pink in the middle. Cut one open to check — the inside should be brown all the way through before you serve.

Done looks like: golden outside, brown all through, juices run clear.

Screen stays on while you cook

Method · step 5 of 5

Plate with lemon & tomato

Serve with lemon wedges and sliced tomatoes, a scatter of the herbs.

The lemon & tomato aren’t a garnish — the vitamin C helps the iron absorb.

Done looks like: cutlets plated, lemon & tomato on the side.
